notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.13.44.

Open Orders stays where you were + POS no longer goes off when locked
- Tapping a table in Open Orders / Home to see its items and pressing Back now returns to the same place in the list, not the first table
- Back from an order goes to the screen you came from
- If Android closes the POS screen while the phone is locked or the app is minimized, the app now reopens it by itself and shows a "Zaiqa POS stopped — tap to open" alert until it is back
- New permission step "Display over other apps" (red bar / Cloud settings card): lets the app reopen and keeps it alive
- Cloud settings card shows reopen status
